summary: Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the final voting map from an Extraordinary General Stockholders' Meeting held on April 28, 2026. Shareholders approved multiple items including the merger of Banco Itaucard S.A. into the company without capital increase, based on a December 31, 2025 balance sheet, and the ratification of PwC as appraiser. The merger consolidates a wholly-owned subsidiary. No deal terms such as price or premium are specified. This represents an internal restructuring rather than a third-party acquisition. All items passed with near-unanimous approval. Watch for the effective merger date and any subsequent regulatory filings.
